recipe.visualDefinition: A somber, low-key portrait of a young man in soft focus, with a sharp, high-contrast instant film photograph clipped to a wire in front of his face. The photograph reveals a detailed, emotional close-up of a young woman's eye and face, creating a composite identity effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground instant photo obscuring the background subject's right eye
Sharp focus on the clipped photo versus soft focus on the background figure
Horizontal clothesline wire bisecting the upper third of the frame
Cool blue ambient lighting contrasting with warm skin tones in the photo insert
coreInvariants: White border on the instant photo
Centrally aligned typographic stack in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Background male figure is medium-close up, slightly off-center; foreground photo is centered and scaled to approximately 25% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, detailed eye within the instant photo frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sharp instant photo, moves down to the bold white title text, then out to the blurred background face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark blue negative space in the upper corners and lower background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and slate blue (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (photo border and primary title text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background; higher saturation and contrast within the small photo frame.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide tracking for the main title
Condensed width for the red metadata text

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the dark clothing of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between wide, airy white geometric sans and tight, bold red condensed sans.
graphicDevices: Play button icon (triangle) following the main title

preserve: Wide tracking of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity and modern feel for the main title.
Impactful condensed look for the red metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cinematic portrait of a young man in soft focus against a dark blue vignetted background. A thin horizontal wire runs across the top third. A sharp, white-bordered instant photo is clipped to the wire with a blue binder clip, positioned over the man's face. The photo shows a high-contrast, sharp close-up of a woman's eye and cheek.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text in the lower third. Top line: small, bold, red condensed sans-serif. Middle line: large, white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif followed by a small white triangle. Bottom line: very small white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the instant photo sharp while the background is blurred?
Is the red text clearly legible against the dark background?
Is the binder clip blue and metallic?
Is the tracking on the main title wide and even?

avoid: Low-resolution textures on the photo frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the wire appears to be under tension
Check that the photo border has a realistic paper texture
Verify the red text is a pure, vibrant red (#E50914 style)
Confirm the background subject is sufficiently out of focus to not compete with the photo
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered identity composition: [Blurred Background Subject] + [Horizontal Wire] + [Sharp Foreground Photo Insert] + [Tri-color Typographic Stack]
